criteria.title: 초기 finite state 구성
criteria.text:
primary curls 뒤temporal mean update와다섯moment correction을수행하여j=0 상태를만든다. 합격: Proposition9.5
의B0=0.7,C0*=1.2와(9.9),(9.10) 명세를충족한다. 명세의상수없이경험적power slope만으로인증하지않는다.
remaining: Apply temporal mean and five-moment corrections to the actual full-curl primary state.
Recompute its pressure and establish the original B0,C0 and cumulative class bounds with constants.
remainingObligations: Apply temporal mean and five-moment corrections to the actual full-curl primary state.
Recompute its pressure and establish the original B0,C0 and cumulative class bounds with constants.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The inherited uncorrected primary/curl/residual roots and exact source namespace are pinned. The required actual j=0 state has not been constructed.

criteria.title: 전체 residual 재계산
criteria.text:
R(u+δu,p+δp)=R(u,p)+Lu(δu,δp)+div(δu⊗δu)를사용하며매substep 후최신압력을복원한다. 합격: 독립직접PDE
평가와decomposed residual이오차예산내일치한다. 기존flat tail와새quadratic remainder를장부에서누락하지않
는다.
remaining: Compute the full actual PDE residual and its split after each real source update.
Carry old flat tails and every new quadratic/curl term through the same pressure reconstruction.
remainingObligations: Compute the full actual PDE residual and its split after each real source update.
Carry old flat tails and every new quadratic/curl term through the same pressure reconstruction.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The complete quadratic finite Fourier residual identity is executed, with an omitted-square negative control. The updated paper state and pressure are not yet inputs.

criteria.title: 비영 angular harmonics 보정
criteria.text:
현재source의모든nonzero harmonics를(7.13) inverse로풀고source-supported potentials에cutoff 후curl한다.
합격: same-label 곱에서m+m′ 신규주파수가생성된다. 단계별최대harmonic을기록하고조용한truncation 대신
discarded-mode bound를제공한다.
remaining: Derive all coefficient sources from the actual same-label full state.
Use original smooth phase/coefficient jets and supported full curls, including their commutators and mode tails.
remainingObligations: Derive all coefficient sources from the actual same-label full state.
Use original smooth phase/coefficient jets and supported full curls, including their commutators and mode tails.
criteria.acceptanceScope: All pairwise harmonics of a declared finite set are enumerated; truncation without a bound is held. The projected equation (7.13) is solved on an explicit finite coefficient model and compared to an exact ODE.

criteria.title: Signed covariance increment
criteria.text:
고정positive a±에대해δa=(Hcov^−1(Σ/ε))/(2a)를사용한다. 새Σ는signed일수있다. 합격: B(W0,LΣ)=Σ와(7.41)의
세remainder를모두검사한다. 앞단계a±를새residual에맞춰몰래재선택하지않는다.
remaining: Feed the actual updated signed stress into the authentic original covariance inverse.
Construct the physical correction and verify all current-state cross/curl/square remainders and derivative classes.
remainingObligations: Feed the actual updated signed stress into the authentic original covariance inverse.
Construct the physical correction and verify all current-state cross/curl/square remainders and derivative classes.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The signed finite inverse fixes positive base amplitudes and retains the increment square and all three remainder families. Original M2 H/a roots are separately pinned.

criteria.title: Zero auxiliary mean Fourier inverse
criteria.text:
(8.19)의1/(2πi vt·k) multiplier로(8.20)을풀고axial increment는(8.14)의potential로실현한다. 합격: zero mode가
0이고Nφ=F가맞는다. |vt·k|^−1≤C(1+|k|) 및4개추가도함수를포함한Fourier tail를기록한다.
remaining: Compute the actual source Fourier coefficients and its C^(m+4) constants.
Realize the axial potential and retain the radial cutoff remainder in the new physical pressure/residual.
remainingObligations: Compute the actual source Fourier coefficients and its C^(m+4) constants.
Realize the axial potential and retain the radial cutoff remainder in the new physical pressure/residual.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The actual vt=(sqrt(2)-1,1) algebraic divisor is rationalized with a nonzero integer norm; real finite Fourier inputs are inverted, and mean/divisor/tail guards execute.

criteria.title: 다섯 radial equations와 압력
criteria.text:
(8.25)로두보존모멘트와P,Jθ,Jz를보정하고(8.12)로pressure를다시계산한다. 합격: 두보존적분은0으로유지되고새
결함은(8.26),(8.27)의nonlinear remainder와일치한다. λ의작은값에따른condition number를통제한다.
remaining: Compute P,Jtheta,Jz from the complete current curl state.
Apply the source map to those defects and reconstruct pressure by (8.12).
Recompute (8.26)-(8.27) including all current means and attach the required derivative constants.
remainingObligations: Compute P,Jtheta,Jz from the complete current curl state.
Apply the source map to those defects and reconstruct pressure by (8.12).
Recompute (8.26)-(8.27) including all current means and attach the required derivative constants.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The actual unmodified M2 mean patch executes through its original helpers. Original positive lambda/a, five disjoint source profiles, enclosed positive moments, angular inverse and lambda-factored axial inverse are installed; this closes the fixed inverse dependency. A separate finite five-integral example also executes.

criteria.title: 고정 도메인과 차수 향상
criteria.text:
σj=1/5+j/10, gj=hj/10 및(9.17),(9.18)의Km,ℓm,log powers를추적한다. 합격: 모든finite stage가같은q<qbig 도메
인을사용한다. 단한번의step에서샘플잔차가늘면정밀도/범위/상수부터조사하고차수theorem과혼동하지않는다.
remaining: Instantiate one common qbig and actual source derivative constants for every finite stage.
Compute the stage field, physical derivative losses and retained tails on that same domain.
remainingObligations: Instantiate one common qbig and actual source derivative constants for every finite stage.
Compute the stage field, physical derivative losses and retained tails on that same domain.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Exact rational exponent inequalities and the fixed-domain obligation are tracked. No empirical slope is promoted to class membership.

criteria.title: 최종 local 합성
criteria.text:
(9.21)에서Aj,Bj,pj에shrinking cutoff를적용하고curl하여local field를만든다. finite residual의flat terms를무조건합
산하지않는다. 합격: Lemma5.4의tail 비교로(9.20)을연결한다. 평가구간의active indices와생략tail의bound를저장
하고없으면finite-stage approximation으로제한한다.
remaining: Construct the actual finite correction sequence.
Choose shrinking cutoffs with differentiated summable tails and perform the Lemma5.4 fixed-stage comparison.
Store active indices and the omitted-tail bound for each evaluated domain.
remainingObligations: Construct the actual finite correction sequence.
Choose shrinking cutoffs with differentiated summable tails and perform the Lemma5.4 fixed-stage comparison.
Store active indices and the omitted-tail bound for each evaluated domain.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The finite-stage/local-field distinction is enforced. The source correction sequence and its final cutoff sum are absent.
